integrity: A complete analytic proof and standalone integer/rational finite checker are included. Finite checks corroborate rather than imply the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Hausdorff and minimum normalized-Hamming claims for ordinary reversal of the oriented cyclic integral of a mechanical Sturmian shift; no edit distance, letter relabeling, general cocycles, or arbitrary-base assertion. The O(log n) error needs bounded-type irrational slope; unbounded-type slopes have o(n) only. Priority is conditional on inspected sources; independent audit not performed.
title: Parity dichotomy in the reversal Hamming spectrum of Sturmian integral lifts
